Across 864 graded NCAAW games the algo now scales scoring ×0.973 and gives home teams +1.3 points. Team corrections so far: Cardinals attack ×0.979, defense ×1.031 (4 games); Flames attack ×1.005, defense ×0.960 (6 games).
